release_policy.editorial_use: Allowed only for claim records marked claim_ready_editorial and with all attached inference boundaries preserved.
release_policy.question_use: Allowed only for claim IDs explicitly released by a resolved topic direct-object gate. Persistent identity, at least two direct-object locators and rights-compatible History Go use are mandatory.
release_policy.production_source_extensions: A production-specific fulltext source may be registered inside the evidence layer without incrementing the canonical bibliographic basis. It must carry full bibliographic identity, registration reason and fulltext verification.
release_policy.nonredistributable_objects: Objects whose record prohibits redistribution or modification remain external-link-and-metadata-only in History Go.
release_policy.chapter_use: This index does not by itself make a six-topic domain chapter complete; chapter production must document coverage of every canonical topic used.
